candidates.name: ALLOCATE-INSTANCE
candidates.law: Create a fresh instance of a class without standard MAKE-INSTANCE initialization; standard-class slots are initially unbound.
candidates.positive: Allocate then inspect slot-boundness: slots are unbound, whereas make-instance may apply initform/initargs.
candidates.falsifier: Confusing allocated instance with fully initialized MAKE-INSTANCE result is a semantic failure.

candidates.name: REINITIALIZE-INSTANCE
candidates.law: Changes existing instance slot values according to valid initargs without adding/removing slots and without re-running omitted initforms.
candidates.positive: Instance a=1,b=2 reinit a=3 => same instance with a=3,b=2.
candidates.falsifier: Fail if b resets to initform or the instance layout changes.

candidates.name: ADD-METHOD
candidates.law: Attach an existing method object to a generic function, updating dispatch membership under agreement rules; assess whether action is derivable from already selected DEFMETHOD or a new effect law.
candidates.positive: After adding a :before method its descriptor can be found; unaffected primary methods still exist.
candidates.falsifier: Registering a method under a different generic function or duplicating agreeing signatures without replacement policy is invalid.

candidates.name: ENSURE-GENERIC-FUNCTION
candidates.law: Creates a new generic function for an unbound global function name or returns/modifies an existing generic descriptor; rejects ordinary-function/macro collision.
candidates.positive: Repeated ensure on an existing generic reuses its identity and leaves unrelated methods intact.
candidates.falsifier: Fail if existing ordinary function is silently overwritten or unrelated methods vanish.

scope: Only four candidates in this tranche. All branch research is not claimed to be exhausted.
